'''Strom''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an aide to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Leontyne Saresh|Saresh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Strom was a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he served as an aide to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Politics|politician]] who led a project called [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], seeking to restore the planet.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{GameLSmechanics}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}} [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] is visited during Chapter I of the Republic classes so it can be said that its planetary quests are set in [[3643 BBY]].</ref> he was approached by a Republic-aligned individual at the [[Olaris]] [[Olaris Spaceport|Spaceport]] and asked them to meet Governor Saresh in her [[Planetary Governor office|office]], to help with the restoration project.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Strom was [[Color/Legends|tan]]-skinned, with brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].

==Behind the scenes==
Strom appears in the "Reconstruction Efforts" Republic-only mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
